description: A file-upload-policy artifact defines allowed MIME types, size limits, storage access controls, and scanning rules for every file upload surface.

rules.description: Policy must declare at least one upload_surface with id, allowed_mime_types, and max_size.
public_read must not be true and storage_acl must not be 'public-read' — files must be private by default.
Executable and script MIME types (application/x-executable, text/html, application/javascript, etc.) must not be in allowed_mime_types.
Extensions like .exe, .sh, .php, .asp, .js, .html must not be in allowed_extensions.
Upload surfaces accessible to untrusted users must declare malware_scan: true or scanning provider.
